Simulation software: OpenFOAM, solver interFoam (VOF, MULES interface capturing).
Geometry: Rectangular tank, 1.0 m in x, 0.6 m in y, 0.1 m in z. Gravity vector g = (0, -9.81, 0) m/s².
Mesh: Structured (or equivalent) 200 × 120 × 1 cells in x-y-z. Front and back z-faces are set as empty boundary type, making the simulation quasi-2D.
Patches: bottom (y=0), left (x=0), right (x=1.0), top/open (y=0.6), front (z=0), back (z=0.1).
Initial condition: Water volume fraction alpha.water = 1 below a staircase approximation of a tilted free surface defined by 10 x-slices of 0.1 m width. Slice 0 (x in [0.0,0.1]): water up to y=0.255. Slice 1 (x in [0.1,0.2]): water up to y=0.265. Continue stepping +0.01 m per slice through Slice 9 (x in [0.9,1.0]): water up to y=0.345. All other cells are air (alpha.water=0). Velocity U = (0,0,0) everywhere. p_rgh = 0 everywhere. The tank is stationary throughout; no moving mesh, no source terms, no imposed oscillation.
Initial fill level: Approximately 50 percent by volume (mean water depth 0.30 m in a 0.6 m tall tank).
Boundary conditions on solid walls (bottom y=0, left x=0, right x=1.0): U = noSlip, p_rgh = fixedFluxPressure, alpha.water = zeroGradient.
Boundary conditions on open top face (y=0.6): U = pressureInletOutletVelocity, p_rgh = totalPressure with p0 set to 0 (gauge/atmospheric), alpha.water = inletOutlet with inletValue 0.
Boundary conditions on z-faces (front and back): empty.
Physical properties in transportProperties: transportModel Newtonian. Water (phase1): rho = 1000 kg/m³, nu = 1e-6 m²/s. Air (phase2): rho = 1 kg/m³, nu = 1.5e-5 m²/s. Surface tension sigma = 0.0728 N/m. ContactAngle = 0 (fully wetting walls). Laminar flow (no turbulence model, RASModel none).
Time control in controlDict: startTime 0, endTime 10 (ten seconds of physical time), deltaT 1e-3 (initial), adjustTimeStep yes, maxCo 0.5, writeInterval 0.05 (producing 200 output snapshots).
Pressure reference: pRefCell = 0, pRefValue = 0 (standard defaults in fvSolution).
Discretization and solver settings: Use standard interFoam/MULES defaults consistent with OpenFOAM tutorials (Euler time scheme for ddt, Gauss linear or limited-linear for div(U), Gauss linear corrected for laplacian, corrected snGradSchemes, MULES with nAlphaCorr 1, nAlphaSubCycles 2, cAlpha 1, PIMPLE with 1 outer corrector and 1 pressure corrector).
Purpose: Capture the transient gravity-driven free-surface oscillation of a tilted water column released from rest in a stationary rectangular tank, with realistic viscous wall damping, over approximately ten seconds covering several damped sloshing periods.
